_about: Where each terrain note happens, for its micro-screenshots (scripts/gen/terrain_shots.py -> icons/terrain/<code>_<i>.webp, i counting spots in file order). A row whose text starts with 'match' shows the pictures of its 'spots' ([x, y] game units: the centre of a square 2r wide; for a moved object the midpoint of its old and new spot). Picked from scripts/gen/terrain_audit.py and the map files; a note whose change can't be seen on the map (a camp's evolutions) has no entry.
